claim: Napoleon compiles its fx sources at runtime with D3DX (it imports D3dx9d_40.dll, the debug build); every captured shader's CTAB names "Microsoft (R) HLSL Shader Compiler 9.24.950.2656" (ps_2_0, ps_3_0, vs_2_0, vs_3_0) with CTAB flags 0x20001000; compiling the shipped fx with d3dx9_40.dll of that version (D3DXCreateEffectCompilerFromFileW + CompileEffect, flags 0x1000) reproduces them byte for byte
